title: Boomerang-shaped craft over Tucson

tellings.quote: Oh, yeah. My wife and I did in Tucson, Arizona. Broad daylight. A boomerang shaped craft below traffic pattern altitude.

plain: A boomerang-shaped craft flew in broad daylight over Tucson, Arizona, lower than the height where planes circle to land. Eric W. Davis, a physicist who has advised the Pentagon, tells Michels he and his wife saw it themselves, so this would be an unknown craft seen up close by a scientist.
